blocked_scopes.reason: Pinned draft/Solidity/reference/Noir commitment misalignment in the existing alignment audit. No adapter/fixtures/mutations; no fresh claim about upstream latest.

claim: RSI v0 demonstrates the same generic conformance architecture across ten bounded, source-pinned real relation families. It discriminates selected locally valid substitutions and claim promotions using separately implemented expectation predictors, frozen admission and 84 mapped killed mutations, without domain-specific generic core branches. This is an implementation-facing cross-repository conformance plane for the validated surfaces, not universal security or ecosystem-wide verification.
limitations: Finite fixture and mutation corpus; mutation count is not completeness.
Shared source interpretation, data origins, codec/admission and Python/Node primitives can create common-mode errors.
H2 catches two selected common-mode experiments for Crystal only; score remains 10/15 MODERATE, authorship/procedural blindness unproven.
Source assumptions, supplied anchors/context and test-only behavior never become production authority.
No universal security, mathematical completeness, end-to-end agent execution, full payment security, consensus correctness or novelty claim.
release_rule: Create annotated v0 only after this research-only closure commit has all required exact-HEAD workflows successful. Tag annotation and delivery record carry final commit/CI IDs.

source_audit.method: Re-run each offline fail-closed source verifier against exact tracked source material. This is pin integrity, not a claim that all upstream main branches remain unchanged.

transport: rsi-json-ascii.v0: ASCII/safe-integer carrier, source-defined exact hex/decimal strings for large integers and bytes. No generic full-JCS/Unicode/float guarantee.
